description: The figure illustrates two stacked line plots showing a repeating zigzag (sawtooth-like) trajectory of a black solid line as a function of an x-axis labeled \(m\), with each plot also including several gray dashed guide lines and a vertical dashed reference near a labeled point \(m_0\). In both plots, the x-axis is drawn as a slanted arrow labeled \(m\) with no numeric tick marks; a point labeled \(m_0\) appears toward the right side. The y-axis in the top plot is an upward arrow labeled \(n\), with several horizontal dashed reference levels labeled (from higher to lower) \(c-a\), \(c-a-s\), and \(w\), and a baseline at 0; no numeric ticks are shown. The y-axis in the bottom plot is an upward arrow labeled “Size\(_{run}\)” with horizontal dashed reference levels labeled \(a\), \(c\), and \(w+a+s\), and a baseline at 0; again, no numeric ticks are shown. In the top plot, the black solid line starts at the origin (0 on the y-axis), rises linearly to a peak near the upper dashed level, then drops sharply to a lower value and repeats this rise-and-drop pattern multiple times across increasing \(m\), with the peaks and troughs forming a regular zigzag; near \(m_0\), a gray dashed vertical line intersects the zigzag and a gray dashed diagonal guide line trends upward across the plot. In the bottom plot, the black solid line similarly begins at 0, rises to a peak near the upper dashed level labeled \(a\), drops sharply, and continues with repeated zigzag cycles across \(m\); near \(m_0\), a gray dashed vertical line is drawn from the zigzag down toward the x-axis, and a gray dashed diagonal guide line also trends upward across the plot.
